title: ocimum ericoides
intro: Ocimum ericoides, commonly known as Indian borage or Mexican tea, is a perennial herb belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is prized for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. The therapeutic actions of Ocimum ericoides include its ability to exhibit analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for conditions such as bronchitis, asthma, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Ocimum ericoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
